scope: Independent read-only final source follow-up to root-authority v1, covering acquired-root identities, cold root confirmation, migration alias/retired source lifecycle and startup diagnostic write authorization. Also rechecks the two original admission/CLI fixes. No reviewer runtime/native/GUI/MCP execution.
outcome: No remaining actionable source finding identified within the bound partial root-authority scope. This is a source review, not runtime or whole-P5 acceptance.

closedFindings.problem: Released/cancelled/replaced host admissions left pending same-epoch rows exempted solely by the ledger live set.
closedFindings.fixVerified: held() now requires actual isTurnCurrent(scopeOf(row))===true in addition to epoch/live; cancellation, replacement, changed sequence/generation/driver identity and release hold the successor.

closedFindings.problem: Recursive CLI transcript-missing retry bypassed the driver guard and skipped the admit block.
closedFindings.fixVerified: runClaudeTurn now asserts session owner, awaits DesktopExecutionHooks.guard and reasserts owner at the common entry reached by the recursive retry.

closedFindings.problem: A data directory replaced after acquiring the OS lease but before runtime initialize was accepted under the same canonical pathname; identity was captured only from the replacement.
closedFindings.fixVerified: ServerOwnership captures existing canonical directory dev/ino/birthtimeNs before binding/return; isRootCurrent checks this captured root independently of kernel-handle isHeld. Runtime verifies canonical membership plus isRootCurrent before mkdir, confirmRoot after mkdir, and ongoing rootOwned checks include both retained acquisition identity and runtime double-inode checks.
closedFindings.testSource: actual lease acquired before directory rename/recreate; initialize refuses and replacement directory remains empty. Existing post-initialize replacement test remains.

closedFindings.problem: Re-resolving migratedFrom through the new old-name junction lost the pre-move source identity; startup release also rejected a valid migration when old-name junction creation failed.
closedFindings.fixVerified: rootAliases captures each original requested alias to its acquisition-time canonical root. confirmRoot obtains the original source identity from that saved mapping and requires exact destination inode equality before retiring source. releaseStartup excludes only these verified-retired source aliases and still checks each retained destination/current root identity.
closedFindings.testSource: separate actual lease tests cover missing cold root, confirmed rename with old symlink, and confirmed rename without old symlink.

closedFindings.origin: parent identified; reviewer agreed and reviewed fix
closedFindings.problem: startServer catch called writeStartError after initialization had refused a replaced root; diagnostic mkdir/write could mutate the unowned replacement.
closedFindings.fixVerified: writeStartError itself asks canWriteStartupError before mkdir and again after its async completion. On macOS canWriteStartupError uses rootOwned; unestablished identity, replacement or lost lease refuses. An already verified root may receive startup diagnostics even after runtime phase failed. Non-macOS behavior is retained.
closedFindings.testSource: actual replaced root invokes real writeStartError and remains empty. Credential test exercises deny-before-mkdir and authority loss during awaited mkdir, retaining prior envelope/800-character/original-error assertions.

additionalAssessment.generation: Only undefined defaults to zero. Admission requires raw safe nonnegative integer; string/null/nonfinite values cannot alias zero. current() compares the raw live generation.
additionalAssessment.kernelAndRootAuthority: isHeld tracks actual retained OS handle lifecycle; isRootCurrent separately checks a requested canonical data root. A verified migrated source is retired and cannot become current again merely through old-name alias resolution.
additionalAssessment.coldRoot: Only roots acquired as missing can bind their first identity, while the macOS startup gate is still retained. A second confirmation of an already bound root cannot replace its identity. Root confirmation precedes ledger directory/state creation.
additionalAssessment.migration: 13 confirms destination against acquisition-time source inode explicitly after authorized migration and before Desktop initialization. Both old-name symlink success and failure preserve source evidence at the destination.
additionalAssessment.entryAndContinuationGates: Driver/provider/CLI/subagent guards remain as reviewed in v1; root runtime still exposes preparation only, and ordinary callTool/required env/dispatch/result/delivery/CLI root-RPC integration remains incomplete.
additionalAssessment.diagnosticLimit: The source fix prevents diagnostic mutation when root authority is already false before mkdir or becomes false during that awaited step; this source review is not a general OS adversarial filesystem-race qualification of all existing writers.
